chains.name: ExportChain
chains.about: Handles the Export CSV Register secondary action. @param {Object} context

chains.name: FiltersChangedChain
chains.about: Fires when the Utilization Period control changes — the preset select, or either date picker when the preset is Custom. Bound via `on-value-changed="[[$listeners.onFilterChanged]]"` on all three controls. The window is the only page-level filter left: everything else on this page is a smart-search chip, handled by OnAnalyticsSmartSearchChangedChain. fromDate/toDate are REQUIRED by the yard-utilization view and are supplied by the page, never by search (see reportCriterion ENDPOINT_PARAMS), which is why this chain owns them.

chains.name: OnAnalyticsSmartSearchChangedChain
chains.about: Coalesce keystrokes into one request. filter-criterion-changed fires per keystroke; without this, typing "excavator" issues nine round-trips and the last to RETURN — not the last sent — could win and paint stale rows.

chains.name: TabChangedChain
chains.about: Fires when the analytics tab-bar selection changes. Loads the newly-active tab's live rows (no-op while useMockData=true). KPIs are unchanged by a tab switch, so they aren't refetched here.

chains.name: enforcePageAccessChain
chains.about: Page-level RBAC deep-link guard. GENERATED - every copy is byte-identical; change the template and regenerate rather than editing one copy. Copies exist because a page's eventListeners resolve a bare chain id against that page's OWN <page>-chains folder, so an app-level chain referenced by name 404s. This file holds NO policy: the decision (canEnterPage), the page code (getPageCodeForPage), the redirect target (getRoleHomeTarget) and the same-flow test (isSameFlow) all live in $application.functions. Deriving the page code at runtime is what lets every copy be identical.

chains.name: onSelectedKpiChangedChain
chains.about: Fires when a KPI tile is selected on the scoreboard. @param {Object} context @param {Object} params @param {string} params.value — the selected KPI id

chains.name: vbEnterChain
chains.about: Initial load. The four tab grids bind SDPs and fetch themselves, so this chain only: 1. seeds the Utilization date window (fromDate/toDate are REQUIRED), and 2. fetches the KPI roll-up (yard-stock?groupBy=unitStatus) for the tiles. Static tab definitions live in $page.variables defaults; the old mock KPI/filter/chart seeding is gone (data is live via SDP).

modules.name: lineStatusLabels
modules.about: Single source of truth for line-status display strings. Pages and chains that render lineStatus should import this module instead of defining their own map, so labels stay in sync. Vocabulary matches EQR_EQUIPMENT_REQUEST_LINE.lineStatus values driven by the cascade in saveLineChain.js / confirmRequest path.

modules.name: analyticsData
modules.about: Equipment Analytics — shared data helpers for the SDP-backed analytics page. The four tab grids bind their SDPs directly (live, no cache), so this module is NOT a fetch layer for the lists. It only covers the bits the SDPs can't do themselves: the KPI roll-up and the chart series, both from the live `groupBy` aggregate endpoints, plus the date-window math for Utilization. WHY THIS EXISTS Both pages render with oj-data-grid + a custom DataGridProvider, which cannot be driven by a ServiceDataProvider/ListDataProviderView the way oj-table can. So instead of an SDP transform, the criterion is translated here and handed to the same `Actions.callRest` the pages already use — the search is genuinely server-side, it just isn't wearing an SDP. ## What this page is for
- Equipment Analytics is a read-only analytics view over yard stock and yard utilization in the "Old EquipRite" app (flow `equipment-foundation`, page `equipment-analytics`).
- It shows KPI tiles (a roll-up of yard stock grouped by unit status), a tab bar with four tab grids, and chart series built from aggregate endpoints.
- Tab 4 is the yard × day utilization grid for a date window. The facts do not name the other three tabs.
- The page does not create or update anything: every REST call in the facts is a GET.

## How people use it
- Open the page. The KPI tiles load and the active tab's grid fetches its own rows.
- Pick a Utilization Period preset in the Period select, or choose Custom and set the dates. The field list has both Start Date/End Date and From/To; the facts do not say which pair drives the window.
- Type in the smart search ("Search by equipment, project, yard…") to filter. Every filter other than the date window is a smart-search chip.
- Switch tabs on the tab bar to see a different grid. The KPI tiles do not change on a tab switch.
- Select a KPI tile on the scoreboard. A chain handles the selection, but the facts do not say what it does.
- Click Export CSV to export. The output content and format are not described in the facts.

## Business logic
- **Access guard:** `enforcePageAccessChain` runs on vbBeforeEnter as a deep-link RBAC guard.
  - It holds no policy of its own. The decision (`canEnterPage`), page code (`getPageCodeForPage`), redirect target (`getRoleHomeTarget`) and same-flow test (`isSameFlow`) all live in `$application.functions`.
  - It is a generated, byte-identical copy per page. Change the template and regenerate rather than editing this copy.
- **Page open:** `vbEnterChain` does two things.
  - It seeds the Utilization date window, because fromDate/toDate are required by the yard-utilization view.
  - It fetches the KPI roll-up (`yard-stock?groupBy=unitStatus`) for the tiles.
  - The four tab grids are described as binding SDPs and fetching themselves, and tab definitions are static defaults in `$page.variables`.
- **Date window:** `FiltersChangedChain` fires when the Period preset changes, or when either date picker changes while the preset is Custom.
  - It owns fromDate/toDate. These are always supplied by the page, never by search (see ENDPOINT_PARAMS in `reportCriterion`).
  - The date-window math lives in the `analyticsData` module.
